notes: **REQUIRES JAVASCRIPT RENDERING** - This site uses WP Residence theme with AJAX-loaded listings. The listings are dynamically populated into #listing_ajax_container via JavaScript after page load. Static HTML fetching returns empty container. Requires Playwright/Selenium/browser automation to scrape. The selectors provided are based on common WP Residence theme patterns but cannot be validated without JS execution. Recommended approach: Use headless browser (Playwright/Puppeteer) and wait for #listing_ajax_container to populate before scraping.
